findings.failure_path: When the transcript exceeds the scan limits, tail_only bypasses delivery eligibility entirely. A transcript containing 20,001 unrelated records, a qualifying message and ten tool calls—but no delivery evidence anywhere—therefore blocks Stop. Transcript length is being treated as evidence of delivery, contrary to the acceptance condition.
findings.smallest_fix: Require positive delivery evidence on the overflow path, retaining a bounded delivery marker if necessary. Add a long-transcript negative test with no delivery evidence anywhere.

findings.failure_path: The categorical rule that 'X can be a reference, especially Y' requests Y also matches existing source artifacts. For example, while updating documentation, 'reference-kit can be a reference, especially its migration guide' becomes an obligation to produce a migration guide or report it unfinished. This invents work or reporting noise from material-only guidance. The hook repeats the same instruction; the noise evaluations cover small talk and status questions, not this boundary.
findings.smallest_fix: Distinguish an existing reference artifact from an intended output. For ambiguous material-only readings, require the short interpretation report rather than automatically declaring a deliverable. Add a named-reference-artifact precision scenario.

findings.failure_path: Evidence gap: claim_notice, its state implementation, delivery_reminder, transcript/context_transcript and the outer caller are omitted. Their interaction determines whether claims are atomic, existing reminders survive, and overflow/context notices remain intact. validation.md's source-check assertions cannot independently establish these required containment properties.
findings.smallest_fix: Supply the relevant frozen helper and caller implementations, together with regression assertions covering concurrent claims and existing notice composition.

findings.failure_path: The profile claims the required validation lanes passed, but the landing evidence directs readers to a Final run section that still says 'Pending the last commit.' The recorded review concerns an earlier candidate. Consequently, the packet does not establish that the required lanes passed on the current candidate.
findings.smallest_fix: Record the final candidate identity and actual outcomes for the required lanes, or mark those checks pending and remove the corresponding passed claims.

challenge_focus: Try to break this: a Stop reminder that blocks an agent, an always-on rule that every session reads, and a closeout instruction agents will follow literally. Look for an agent looping or never able to stop; an agent inventing deliverables or reopening settled work because of the reminder; a request it should catch but cannot; authority an agent could wrongly infer; a message that is not from a person triggering it; existing reminders lost or double-firing; evidence claims stronger than the runs support.
